videos.script: A product catalogue with seven categories, written twenty ways. Frutas, frutas, FRUTAS, Fruta. Verduras, and Folhas. {{variants}} Lesson 6 already knows how to fold the first kind. Capitals, spaces, accents. What is left after that is not spelling. It is meaning. {{meaning}} Is Folhas the same category as Verduras? Is Laticínios the same as Ovos e laticínios? A function cannot answer that. A buyer can. {{decide}} So the answer goes in a file. One line per spelling, the category it means, and the department above it. The file is reviewed like code, and it is the only place the decision lives. {{file}} And when a spelling arrives that the file has never seen, the cleaning stops and says so. A new label is a question, not a default. {{stop}} The same idea works across systems. The shops say Cartão and the website says card. One small table, and two channels finally add up. {{end}}
